newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner sees German upturn in Q2 1997.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner sees German upturn in Q2 1997.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG said on Friday it expected German growth to gain strength in the second quarter of 1997, noting that this would copy the development seen in 1996.
The bank's chief economist Klaus Friedrich predicted the economy would grow by 1.5 percent in the second quarter from the first after zero growth in the first quarter.
For the whole of 1997 he expected growth of 2.6 percent compared with 1.9 percent in 1996.
